If  your  business  isn't  making  a  hundred 
 thousand  dollars  a  month,  number  one, 
 grab  a  kitchen  timer  and  then  turn  it  to 
 four  hours.  Number  two,  advertise  until 
 the  timer  is  up.  You  can  do  warm 
 outbound,  cold  outbound,  content,  paid 
 ads.  Don't  do  all  of  them,  just  pick  one 
 until  you  get  to  a  hundred  thousand 
 dollars  a  month.  And  when  that  four-hour 
 timer  is  up  and  the  day  is  done,  just  do 
 it  again  tomorrow.
